settings.archivedNote: This project is archived and cannot be edited
settings.name: Project name
settings.importHint: Paste the docker-compose.yml content. {dockerfile}, {context} and the first port in {ports} are read from the first service that has {build} and filled in for you (one container per project only)
settings.applyParsed: Fill the form with these values
settings.internalPort: Internal port (can be left empty for now)
settings.exposedPort: Exposed port: opens a port on the server that reaches the container directly (empty = through a domain only)
settings.exposedHint: Reachable at {address} → container:{port}. The next deploy has a short downtime while the container is switched (a host port can be bound by one container at a time) · If you already reach the app through a domain (Traefik), {notNeeded}. Leave it empty and a deploy has no downtime, and the previous version is restored automatically when a deploy fails (setting this port gives up that automatic recovery)
settings.exposedHintNotNeeded: you do not need to set this
settings.linkNetwork: Link network: compose projects that use the same name can call each other's components by component name (empty = not linked)
settings.linkNetworkHint: Every component joins the network {network} on the next deploy · Component names must be unique across the projects in the same link
settings.autoDeploy: Auto deploy on push (takes effect once a repository is connected)

error.nameTooLong: The name is longer than 100 characters
error.portRange: The port must be a whole number between 1 and 65535
error.exposedNeedsInternal: Set the internal port before exposing a port on the host
error.linkNetworkFormat: Only a-z, 0-9 and "-" are allowed, up to 40 characters, starting with a letter or digit
